owner_decision: Three streams, run in this order of priority. Set by Yasir 10 Sep 2026.

streams.name: The eight U.S. G-SIBs
streams.why: Global systemically important banks are where twenty years of examiner, capital, and audit history converts directly. They have the largest AI governance build-outs under SR 11-7 and the most established green-card sponsorship records. This is the home-field stream.

streams.name: Frontier AI labs and big-tech AI governance
streams.why: This is where the doctoral research is pointed and where the Audit the Algorithm brand reads as an asset rather than a side business. Lower sponsorship certainty than the banks and far more competition, but the only stream where the AI work is the job rather than a governance layer over someone else's product.

streams.name: Adjunct and professor-of-practice teaching
streams.why: Universities are H-1B cap-exempt, which changes the immigration math entirely - this is the only stream where sponsorship is structurally easier rather than harder. It also compounds: teaching AI audit while writing the dissertation on AI-assisted judgment makes both more credible. Runs alongside a corporate role, it does not replace one.

ranking.rule: Sort by score descending, then sponsor_employer true first, then stream priority ascending.
ranking.note: Scoring lives in scripts/jobs_sources.py. Titles carrying a bullseye AI-governance keyword score 5; seniority adds one; out-of-market subtracts one.
